reason: I already know how to make most of these, kra pao, green curry, tom yum, and when I'm not sure I just ask my free AI app. Paying 99 baht, that's two plates of food for my family, for recipes I already get for free doesn't make sense to me.
objection: Is it really better than the free AI I already use? And 'Ask the chef' is still typing, which is exactly what annoys me when my hands are covered in garlic and fish sauce.
would_change_my_mind: If I could ask the chef out loud, hands-free, instead of typing while I cook.
